name: side-to-side-jump-rope
instructions:
1. Grasp a jump rope with the handles at your sides and the rope behind your heels.
2. Rotate the wrists to generate velocity and help the rope revolve around the body.
3. As the rope moves toward your feet, jump with both legs to allow it to pass underneath.
4. Land to the right of your starting position after the jump.
5. Repeat step #4 but land to the left of your starting position.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions or time.
